simple.meaning: שְׁלָם (shᵉlâm) is a Hebrew word meaning “prosperity.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שְׁלָם (H8001) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 4:17, with occurrences in Ezra, Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁלָם (H8001) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שְׁלָם (H8001) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שְׁלָם (shᵉlâm) / H8001 is traced through Ezra 4:17, Ezra 5:7, Daniel 3:31, Daniel 6:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
